gloss: just before, on the verge of

definitions.gloss: just before, on the verge of, right before
definitions.explanation: The moment immediately before something happens. Often used for dramatic or critical situations where something nearly occurred.

examples.japanese: ⟦{衝突|しょうとつ}→衝突：03235_shoutotsu⟧{寸前|すんぜん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{止|と}まった→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧。
examples.english: It stopped just before the collision.

examples.japanese: ⟦{締|し}め{切|き}り→締め切り：04162_shimekiri⟧{寸前|すんぜん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦レポート→レポート：01543_repooto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: I submitted the report just before the deadline.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{倒産|とうさん}→倒産：03452_tousan⟧{寸前|すんぜん}だった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{投資家|とうしか}→投資家：16242_toushika⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{現|あらわ}れて→現れる：01870_arawareru⟧⟦{助|たす}かった→助かる：01956_tasukaru⟧。
examples.english: The company was on the verge of bankruptcy, but a new investor appeared and saved it.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
{寸前|すんぜん} attaches directly to nouns (X⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{寸前|すんぜん} or X{寸前|すんぜん}) to mean "just before X" or "on the verge of X." It can also follow the dictionary form of verbs with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ or ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (e.g., ⟦{爆発|ばくはつ}→爆発：03575_bakuhatsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧{寸前|すんぜん}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{衝突|しょうとつ}→衝突：03235_shoutotsu⟧{寸前|すんぜん} — just before collision
- ⟦{倒産|とうさん}→倒産：03452_tousan⟧{寸前|すんぜん} — on the verge of bankruptcy
- ⟦{締|し}め{切|き}り→締め切り：04162_shimekiri⟧{寸前|すんぜん} — just before the deadline
- ⟦{崩壊|ほうかい}→崩壊：09067_houkai⟧{寸前|すんぜん} — on the verge of collapse

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{直前|ちょくぜん}→直前：13651_chokuzen⟧ also means just before but is more neutral and commonly used for scheduled events. {寸前|すんぜん} has a more dramatic nuance, often implying a close call or near miss.
